rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hawā is the soul’s spontaneous inclination and bare preference.
rows.anchor: “Hevâ” nefsin kendiliğinden meylettiği arzusu,

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Placing the second object first conveys restriction: they recognize no deity beyond what their desire dictates.
rows.anchor: ikinci mef‘ûlün takdim olunması kasr ifade etmek içindir ki, canının istediğinden başka kendine ilâh tanımayan demektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Such people have no devotion to truth and are simply self-seeking.
rows.anchor: Böyle kimselerde hiç hak perestişi yok, sade bir hodgâmlık vardır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They worship pleasure, disregard proof and rights, and sacrifice truth even when they know their pleasure brings ruin; they reduce religion to personal sensation and refuse God’s pleasure.
rows.anchor: Dini de insanın mücerred hissiyâtından, yani sadece keyif ve zevkinden ibaret tanırlar.

rows.speaker: Ebû Ümâme
rows.claim: A report attributed to Abu Umama says that among objects worshiped besides God, followed desire is the greatest in God’s sight.
rows.anchor: Ebû Ümâme radıyallâhu anh’tan tahric etmişlerdir, demiş ki:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first question is confirmatory, while the second denies that the Prophet can be their guardian or rescue them.
rows.anchor: Evvelki istifham takrîrî, bu istifham inkârîdir. Yani gördün a ona vekil olamazsın, üzerine müvekkel olup da kurtaramazsın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most neither heed transmitted evidence nor act through rational evidence.
rows.anchor: ne delîl-i sem‘î tanır söz dinlerler, ne de delîl-i aklî tanır akıl ile hareket ederler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They resemble cattle because they do not use reason or hearing and follow only their sensations.
rows.anchor: akl ü sem‘e göre hareket etmez, mücerred hissiyâtlarına tâbi‘olurlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Cattle obey their keepers, distinguish benefactors from those who harm them, seek benefit, avoid harm, and know their food and familiar routes.
rows.anchor: en‘âm, ehlî hayvanlar bakanlarına inkıyad ederler, kendilerine iyilik edenlerle

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Cattle use their given faculties as intended and lack beliefs in both good and evil, whereas these people fail even to recognize their Lord and repay His favors with ingratitude.
rows.anchor: Kendilerine verilmiş olan kuvvetleri ta‘tîl etmez, mâ-hulika-lehine sarf eder, hak ve hayır akidesi yoksa zulm ü şer akidesi de yoktur. Onlar ise Rablerini tanımazlar, O’nun ihsanlarına karşı nankörlük ederler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They reject eternal reward and fail to avoid punishment, betray even their homeland, corrupt human nature, foment discord, and disorder the world through oppression, corruption, deception, and seduction.
rows.anchor: ebedî menfaat olan sevâbı istemez, en büyük zarar olan ikābdan korunmazlar, vatanlarına bile hıyanet ederler. Fıtratı bozmaya, fitneler çıkarmaya çalışır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The six days point to the broad developmental moments in the universe’s ordering under the general law of cultivation and development.
rows.anchor: Altı gün hilkat-i âlemin terbiye kanunu mûcebince en umûmî tasnîfindeki tekâmül lahzalarına işarettir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although God can create by the command “Be” in an instant, He unfolds creation through a wise progression from less complete to more complete stages.
rows.anchor: Yaratmak, bir lahzada takdir ve îcad etmek “ol” demekle olduruvermekten ibaret olmakla beraber, O bunların hepsini birden değil, hikem-i sübhâniyesiyle terbiye ede ede nâkıstan kâmile doğru

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sixth day is Friday, the day of gathering, when Adam was created; Adam’s creation and instruction in the names established the caliphate.
rows.anchor: altıncısı insanın yaratıldığı cuma, yani cem‘iyyet günüdür. Âdem’in yaratılması ve esmânın tâlim olunmasıyla taht-ı hilâfet kuruldu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s establishing Himself over the Throne means that He continually exercises rule and sovereignty.
rows.anchor: sonra Arş üzerine istivâ buyurdu icrâ-yı hükm ü saltanat edip duruyor (Sûre-i A‘râf’a bak).

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The name al-Rahman means that all creatures enjoy His mercy.
rows.anchor: Rahmân’dır O bütün mahlûkāt, rahmetinden

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to ask al-Khabir can mean asking Him for whatever one seeks, or asking the all-knowing alone for fuller detail about creation and command because others do not know.
rows.anchor: İşte ne dileyeceksen O Habîr’den dile yahut bu babda bu halk u emr işinde daha ziyade tafsil istersen başkasından değil, her şeyi bilen O Habîr’den sor.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “What is al-Rahman?” may ask about the name’s meaning, referent, or essence, or may be a denial.
rows.anchor: bu ismin mefhûmunu veya müsemmâsını ve mâhiyetini istifsâr olabildiği gibi, inkâr da olur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arabs understood the word’s meaning, so they either did not know it was a name of God or denied God; more precisely, they denied His attribute of mercy and were unfamiliar with it.
rows.anchor: Şüphe yok ki Arab Rahmân kelimesinin mefhûmunu anlamaz değildir. O hâlde ya Allah’ın ismi olduğunu bilmiyorlardı veya Allah’ı inkâr ediyorlardı, daha doğrusu Allah’ın rahmet sıfatını inkâr ediyorlardı.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their reply means they would not prostrate to an unknown thing merely because the Prophet ordered them to.
rows.anchor: yani “bilmediğimiz bir şeye mücerred senin emrinle secde eder miyiz?” dediler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command increased their aversion still further.
rows.anchor: ve bu emir onların daha ziyade vahşetlerini artırdı.

rows.speaker: Dahhâk
rows.claim: Dahhak reports that the Prophet and Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, Uthman b. Mazun, and Amr b. Unaysa prostrated; the polytheists mocked them and withdrew to the other side of the mosque.
rows.anchor: Dahhâk’ten rivayet olunduğuna göre Resûlullah sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem, Ebû Bekir, Ömer, Osman, Ali, Osman b. Maz‘un, Amr b. Uneyse secde ettiler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servants of al-Rahman are fortunate people who know remembrance and gratitude and worship only Him.
rows.anchor: yani zikir ve şükrünü bilerek yalnız O Rahmân’a kulluk eden o bahtiyarlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The grammatical subject’s predicate may be the later statement that they will be rewarded with the chamber; he also allows the description of those who walk gently to serve as the predicate.
rows.anchor: bu mübtedânın haberi tâ sûrenin âhirine doğru gelecek olan أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ’dir. Bununla beraber şu da olabilir:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The eight traits summarize the ideal of Islamic ethics and civilization, and the first describes their general conduct.
rows.anchor: her biri bir zümreyi andıran sekiz sıfatla tavsif olunarak İslâm ahlâk ve medeniyetinin, mefkûresinin bir fezlekesi yapılmıştır. Evvelkisi umûmiyetle sîretlerini gösteriyor

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They walk gently, with calm, dignity, humility, good manners, delicacy, and softness, rather than force, pride, arrogance, disrespect, or harshness.
rows.anchor: Cebbârâne, mağrûrâne, kibirli, saygısız, kaba ve haşin değil; sekînet ve vakar ile mütevâzı‘âne, edîbâne, nâzik ve yumuşak yürürler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They avoid disturbing or harming people, move considerately and mercifully, and spread safety and calm.
rows.anchor: Etraflarını iz‘âc etmez, ezâ vermez,

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When ignorant people taunt them, they say words leading to peace or simply say “peace”; they do not stoop to confrontation and they endure it.
rows.anchor: selâmetle neticelenecek söz söylerler, yahut “selâmetle” derler. Onlara çatmaya tenezzül etmezler, tahammül de ederler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They spend the night prostrating and standing in sincere prayer to their Lord, and even their lying down and rising are for God.
rows.anchor: Rablerine sâcidîn ve kāimîn olarak gecelerler yani gece hânelerine, yataklarına çekildikleri vakit sîretleri bu olur. Rablerine hâlisâne namaz kılarlar.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whether after prayer or at other times, they make escape from Hell their first aspiration and pray continually rather than trust their worship and effort.
rows.anchor: İbadet ve ictihadlarına güvenmeyerek dâima halâsa dua ederler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word gharam presents Hell’s punishment as an inevitable affliction pressing on a person like a creditor on the neck.
rows.anchor: Bir alacaklı gibi enseye binmiş bir belâ-yı mübremdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The distinction between mustaqarr and muqam is difficult; although some assign one to sinners and the other to unbelievers, he prefers a particular place within an abode because that distinction would not apply in Paradise.
rows.anchor: Müstekar âsîlere, mükām küffâra nazaran denilmiş ise de bu mâna cennette cereyan etmeyeceğinden müstekar ikâmetgâh içindeki mevki‘-i mahsus olarak mülâhaza edilmek daha muvâfıktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israf is exceeding proper bounds, and in spending it means going beyond the proper limit of expenditure.
rows.anchor: “İsraf” herhangi bir şeyde haddini aşırmaktır. İnfakta israf da sarfiyâtta haddini aşırmaktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Spending may serve necessity, need, or adornment: eating enough to avoid death is necessary, enough for satiety is a need, and pleasant food is adornment.
rows.anchor: Masraf ya bir zarûret veya bir hâcet veya bir hüsn için yapılır. Zarûrî olan masraf yapılmayınca hayat mümkin olmaz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each person or society has spending limits according to its means; useless, harmful, or unlawful expenditure is waste, as is excessive luxury while God’s servants remain in need.
rows.anchor: Ferd veya cemiyetin kendi kesbine göre bu mertebelerden bir haddi vardır. Şu hâlde ne zarûret, ne hâcet ne de hüsn olmayan, fâidesiz, muzır, gayr-i meşrû cihetlere edilen sarfiyât herkes için israf olduğu gibi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Spending on things that bring good and benefit is production rather than consumption, so it is not waste.
rows.anchor: Hayır ve menfaat getiren şeylere sarfiyât ise istihlâk değil, istihsâl demek olacağından israf olmaz.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They neither stint what is due nor waste; their balanced spending is economy, a balance between the two extremes.
rows.anchor: İşte “iktisad” denilen de budur. “İstivâ”dan “sevâ” gibi, “istikāmet”ten “kavâm”, iki ucun denk gelmesidir ki “muvâzene” dahi deriz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shirk, murder, and adultery are singled out as three of the gravest sins, crimes carried out in the names of religion, civilization, and humanity.
rows.anchor: şirk, katl, zina, kebâirin en büyüğü olan bu üç kebîre din, medeniyet, beşeriyet nâmına işlenip duran cinayetlerden olduğu için burada bilhassa bunlardan ictinab zikredilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The protected soul includes any person whose protection is pledged before God, including one under a safe-conduct; all but a wholly unpledged enemy combatant is inviolable.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın tahrim ettiği, muhterem kıldığı nefsi Allah için söz verilmiş olan herhangi bir nefis

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Killing “by right” refers to such grounds as retaliation and prescribed legal punishment.
rows.anchor: Hak ile başka kısas ve had gibi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Athaman means the consequence or punishment of sin, a burden of guilt.
rows.anchor: İsmin cezâsı vebal.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In Hafs’s reading the pronoun in yakhled is lengthened against the usual rule, likely to signal the extent of permanence and attend to the meaning.
rows.anchor: Hafs kıraatinde bu zamirin kāide hilâfına meddi hulûdun imtidâdına işâreten mâna cânibine riayet için olsa gerektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun refers back to punishment, providing evidence against those who say that abiding forever is in the Fire and not in the punishment.
rows.anchor: Bu zamirin “azâb”a rücû‘u, “hulûd nârdadır, azabda değildir” diyenlerin aleyhine bir delil teşkil eder.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They do not give false testimony and also avoid places where lies and falsification occur.
rows.anchor: yalan yere şâhidlik etmedikleri gibi yalan söylenen ve tezvir yapılan mevki‘lerde de durmazlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laghw is useless or harmful activity that ought to be abandoned.
rows.anchor: “Lağv” fâidesiz veya muzır olduğundan dolayı terk ü ilgāsı vâcib olan beyhûde şeyler demektir

rows.speaker: Bazıları
rows.claim: Some interpret laghw as anything that is not an act of obedience.
rows.anchor: Bazıları tâat olmayan şeyler diye tefsir etmişlerdir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He rejects that broad interpretation because permissible things are not necessarily laghw even when they are not acts of obedience.
rows.anchor: fakat mubah olan şeyler tâat olmamakla beraber lağv da değildir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They do not seek out trivialities, but if they happen upon them, they pass by with dignity.
rows.anchor: haysiyetleriyle kerîmâne geçer giderler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He explains this by linking it to Qasas 28:55, where people hear laghw, turn away, state that each side has its own deeds, and say peace.
rows.anchor: bunun tefsîri Sûre-i Kasas’ta وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱللَّغْوَ أَعْرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ لَنَآ أَعْمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا نَبْتَغِى ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ âyetidir [28/55]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When reminded of their Lord’s signs, they do not collapse over them as deaf and blind; they listen and heed with eyes and ears open.
rows.anchor: yani kendilerine ihtar yapıldığı, va‘z u nasihat olunduğu, ders verildiği vakitler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The request allows two grammatical senses: grant spouses and children who are an eye’s joy, or grant joy, blessings, and happiness through spouses and children.
rows.anchor: iki mâna câizdir: Birisi “bizlere gözler sürûru zevceler ve zürriyetler ver” demek, diğeri de “zevcelerimiz ve zürriyetlerimiz yüzünden bizlere gözler sürûru nimetler, saadetler ver” demektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This prayer shows the importance attached to educating one’s family and children.
rows.anchor: Bu talep aile ve evlâd terbiyesine verilen ehemmiyeti gösterir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The muttaqin are fortunate people protected by God from Hell’s punishment.
rows.anchor: müttakīler, Allah’ın vikāyesiyle cehennem azâbından korunan bahtiyarlardır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Imam means a leader or forerunner whom others follow.
rows.anchor: “İmâm” pîşvâ, öncül, kendisine iktidâ edilen metbû‘demektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aspiring to lead the God-fearing, not merely to be righteous, is a lofty sacred collective ideal that shows the greatness of the servants’ spirits and ambition.
rows.anchor: Yalnız müttakī olmak değil, müttakīlerin imamı olmak arzusu ne büyük gaye, ne mukaddes mefkûredir.
